answer: Copying becomes a race the attacker always loses, and producing 59 original texts is the only way to fill 55 aliases; the willow log preserves both halves. The reveal must open the same grove hash, and a reveal that arrives late or mismatched is dropped at the knoll gate. Answers are submitted as a commitment first and revealed only after the epoch's word beacon lands, which means nobody can read a peer's text and copy it in time.
